## CodeQL / Clear-text logging of sensitive information

This logs sensitive data returned by [an access to claudeAiOauth](1) as clear text.

[Show more details](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/security/code-scanning/309)

## CodeQL / Incomplete URL substring sanitization

'[https://router.test/api/services/codex/v1](1)' can be anywhere in the URL, and arbitrary hosts may come before or after it.

[Show more details](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/security/code-scanning/310)
